estimated.title: Wait, what are estimated payments?
estimated.p1: Here's the deal: the City wants their money upfront.
estimated.p4: If your income drops next year, you've already paid based on this year. You'll get it back eventually, but your cash flow takes the hit now.
estimated.p2: Every April, you don't just pay taxes on last year's income — you also pre-pay a chunk of next year's taxes based on what you made this year.
estimated.p3: That means you're fronting the city money that you haven't earned yet.
